Hi Baban team,

I noticed your British-made sleepsuits run in 2-packs and 4-packs from newborn to 24 months, alongside a dedicated premature range in 3-5lb and 5-8lb sizes. With that many size and pack combinations, keeping each variant in stock gets harder as holiday gift-set orders pick up.
